every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 varies camera angles dynamically from an overview in frame 1 to close-ups in frames 6 and 8, whereas Site 1 mainly pans sideways and overlaps text with machines in frames 6 and 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 2 concretely visualizes compression in frame 3, line relocation in frame 6, and seven harness lanes in frame 8, whereas Site 1 uses generic machine icons in frame 9.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2 features detailed mechanical assemblies like rollers and pistons in frames 3-4, while Site 1 relies on simpler blocky shapes with flat shading in frames 3-5.

type_and_layout.reason: Both sites use clean, readable left-aligned dark cards with clear hierarchy across frames 1-9, though Site 2 has a minor spacing typo on the button in frame 1.

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers more purposeful 3D mechanical metaphors and varied camera choreography that directly illustrate how Straitjacket bounds output and coordinates harnesses.
